audience_acfun_detail: Live directory and room details use onlineCount. Likes and followers remain separate; author search has no concurrent count.
audience_bilibili_detail: List online and heartbeat are popularity; WATCHED_CHANGE is cumulative for the session, all kept separate from concurrent viewers
audience_cc_detail: webcc_visitor/hot_score/visitor are aliases for platform heat; only vision_visitor/online_num are current viewers, and both scales remain separate
audience_douyin_detail: Recommendation, search and room payloads prefer top-level or nested user_count as concurrent viewers; display_value/total_user remain cumulative views
audience_douyu_detail: Public ol/hot list fields are treated as popularity
audience_huajiao_detail: Directory heat is platform popularity; no separate concurrent viewer count is exposed
audience_huya_detail: Current list/detail totalCount and userCount plus in-room iAttendeeCount (URI 8006) are all heat in live captures; the public feed does not expose a distinct concurrent count
audience_inke_detail: Public discovery and room details do not expose a verified audience count; missing values stay unknown
audience_kilakila_detail: watchNumber has no verified concurrent-viewer meaning and is not used for real-online ranking
audience_kuaishou_detail: watchingCount is treated as current viewers
audience_metric_fallback_desc: Concurrent mode uses only explicit concurrent values. Supported platforms show Pending until data arrives; other platforms retain Heat or Total labels.
audience_metric_settings_desc: Choose platform heat or real concurrent viewers and manage supported platforms separately
audience_metric_support_detail:
Bilibili, Douyu, Huya, and YY: platform heat
Douyin: total views and concurrent viewers
NetEase CC: webcc/hot/visitor heat and vision concurrent viewers
Kuaishou and Twitch: concurrent viewers
SOOP: total concurrent viewers across PC and mobile

Real-online mode uses data only from platforms that explicitly return an online count. Other platforms show their native metric label.
audience_metric_support_summary: See platform support for heat, online counts, and total views
audience_missevan_detail: The public score is platform popularity; no separate concurrent viewer count is exposed
audience_mode_heat_desc: Use each platform list’s heat or cumulative-view field; these values are not concurrent viewers
audience_mode_online_desc: Rank by concurrent viewers only for enabled rooms with an explicit value; other rooms retain their source metric label
audience_niconico_detail: watchCount is cumulative views for the program and remains separate from concurrent viewers
audience_openrec_detail: Directory and room metadata expose public concurrent viewers. Hidden counts stay unknown; cumulative views are not substituted.
audience_picarto_detail: Directory and room viewers are concurrent viewers; total_views is cumulative and remains separate.
audience_ranking_rule_desc: Ranking order: explicit concurrent counts first, supported rooms awaiting data next, then heat or cumulative metrics. Equal values use stable platform and room IDs to prevent refresh reshuffling.
audience_soop_detail: Recommendation and search prefer total_view_cnt (PC + mobile); categories use view_cnt, explicit platform counts are summed only as a fallback, and missing player-detail counts are not written as zero
audience_source_not_exposed: Source: public platform data has no concurrent count
audience_source_room_realtime: Source: realtime message after entering a room
audience_ttinglive_detail: The homepage directory exposes current viewers. Channel details and favorite refreshes omit this field; missing counts stay unknown.
audience_twitcasting_detail: Directory current_viewer_count is concurrent audience. Room detail omits it; no cumulative count is substituted.
audience_twitch_detail: viewersCount from directory, search and room metadata is shown as the current concurrent viewer count
audience_weibo_detail: Directory and room metadata do not expose a verified audience count; missing values stay unknown
audience_xiaohongshu_detail: Share metadata may contain display text, but no verified numeric concurrent count is used
audience_yy_detail: The public users field is platform heat; the current web API does not expose a separate concurrent count

recorder_input_format_failed: The recorder could not identify this route's media format. It will try the next route or quality.
recorder_input_integrity_failed: The recording input contains damaged packets. Original segments were retained without automatic remuxing or deletion. Inspect the files before deciding whether to record again.
recorder_input_open_failed: The recorder could not open this live CDN route. It will refresh the URL and try the next route or quality.
recorder_input_tail_discarded: Some input was not fully received when stopping and was skipped. The recording may be missing content.
recorder_segment_clock_failed: Recording timestamps are missing or inconsistent. Source segments were retained; finalization stopped.
recorder_task_already_running: Task is already queued or running
recorder_transport_failed: The recorder could not connect to this live CDN. It will refresh the URL and try the next route or quality.

refresh_follow_on_resume_subtitle: Automatically refresh favorites when returning from the background
refresh_rate_balanced_desc: Use the maximum for touch, scrolling and transitions, then return control to the system; cap both danmaku surfaces at 60 FPS.
refresh_rate_mode_hint: The app detects the highest rate supported by the current device and resolution, and applies changes immediately. When danmaku follows the interface policy, room and PiP renderers use this same tier.
refresh_rate_performance_desc: Follow the current device or monitor maximum in the foreground; automatic room and PiP danmaku use that same maximum with higher power or GPU cost.
refresh_rate_power_saving_desc: Let the system schedule the interface dynamically; cap room danmaku at 60 FPS and PiP danmaku at 30 FPS for long viewing.

refresh_thumbnails_desc: Clear the image cache and reload visible covers

xiaohongshu_directory_scope: A public live directory is not integrated. Search a broadcast room ID or import an official /livestream/ share link. Favorites track that room, not the broadcaster across new broadcasts.
xiaohongshu_display_viewers: Platform display count: {value} (not verified concurrent viewers)
xiaohongshu_restricted: Access conditions apply or are unconfirmed. No public full-stream source is available for this room.
xiaohongshu_room_scope: This follows the broadcast room ID. Import a new share link if the broadcaster starts in a different room.
remote_sync_pair_hint: Open PureLive on your phone and scan this code to sync settings.
showroom_directory_scope: Official public live snapshot and native genres. Directory and keyword search page the same snapshot locally. Room links can resolve an offline room; view_num is shown as session total views, not concurrent viewers.
chzzk_directory_scope: Official public popular live directory with inclusive-cursor pagination. Native channel search includes live and offline channels. concurrentUserCount is shown only when cvExposure permits it.
chzzk_adult_notice: This age-rated room did not return a public anonymous media source.
chzzk_region_notice: Playback is restricted for the current region.
chzzk_time_machine_notice: Live HLS is active. The separate time-machine rewind session remains in the next protocol batch.
kick_directory_scope: Official public live directory with native page links. Native search returns live matches and offline channels from the current bounded result window.
kick_mature_notice: This stream is marked as mature content by Kick.
pandalive_directory_scope: The official public live directory uses native pagination. Search combines current-live title/broadcaster matches with BJ profiles including offline broadcasters, each using its own native offset. Exact channel IDs and official live/channel URLs remain supported.
pandalive_chat_notice: PandaTV remote chat is pending. The platform user field is shown as current viewers; playCnt is kept separate from concurrency.
pandalive_adult_notice: This room requires the platform's adult verification.
pandalive_password_notice: This room requires its platform room password.
pandalive_restricted_notice: This room has platform access conditions.
popkontv_directory_scope: The official public directory supports native pagination and Popular, Latest, Rookie, and Hot ordering. Native search accepts channel IDs, nicknames, and official live links, including offline creators.
popkontv_chat_notice: PopkonTV remote chat is pending. watchCnt is shown as current viewers; totalWatchCnt remains a separate cumulative session count.
popkontv_adult_notice: This room requires the platform's adult verification.
popkontv_password_notice: This room requires its platform room password.
popkontv_restricted_notice: This room has platform access conditions.
shopeelive_directory_scope: The Shopee Indonesia homepage exposes a finite public live recommendation snapshot, not a complete catalog. Native search covers snapshot keywords, exact session IDs, and official share URLs.
shopeelive_chat_notice: Shopee Live remote chat is pending. Directory view_count and detail viewer_count are shown as current viewers; member_cnt is not presented as concurrency.
vkvideolive_directory_scope: VK Video Live exposes public categories, an online directory, and native channel search. Pagination preserves the service offset/after cursors, and search includes offline channels.
vkvideolive_chat_notice: VK Video Live remote chat is pending. count.viewers is shown as the current audience while count.views remains a separate cumulative stream metric.
vkvideolive_restricted_notice: This room has platform viewing conditions or playback is paused.
nimotv_directory_scope: A finite snapshot of public recommendations from the official homepage, not a complete catalog. Search covers current snapshot keywords, exact channel numbers, aliases, and official room URLs.
nimotv_chat_notice: NimoTV remote chat is pending. Homepage card counts and room-page viewerNum are shown as current viewers; missing or offline values stay unknown.
dailymotion_directory_scope: The official public API provides a paged live directory sorted by live audience. Native search covers live programs, exact video IDs, official video URLs, and current live videos for exact channel names.
dailymotion_chat_notice: Dailymotion remote chat is pending. The public API does not expose a verified concurrent audience count, so the value remains unknown.
rumble_directory_scope: The public live directory preserves native page numbers. Search matches titles, channels, and categories within each live page and accepts exact live-page or channel URLs.
rumble_chat_notice: Rumble remote chat is pending. Current viewers from live cards and pages stay separate from cumulative VideoObject views.
goodgame_directory_scope: The official API provides a native GoodGame live directory with 50 items per page. Search accepts exact channels, player URLs, and title, streamer, or game matches within each live page.
goodgame_audience_notice: GoodGame viewers is shown as the current audience; rating and premium counters are not audience values.
goodgame_adult_notice: The platform marks this stream as adult content. The current audience still comes from viewers.
fc2live_directory_scope: The official general-audience directory is a finite current snapshot. Categories and keyword search filter that snapshot locally; exact channel IDs and official room URLs also resolve offline rooms.
fc2live_access_restricted: This FC2 broadcast requires login, points, a ticket, or payment and is kept as restricted instead of appearing offline.
fc2live_adult_notice: The platform marks this room as adult content. It is excluded from the general public directory.
fc2live_chat_notice: FC2 remote chat is pending. The media control WebSocket stays owned by playback or recording for the full native input lifetime.
steambroadcast_directory_scope: The official trending community feed is paginated in groups of ten. Keyword search filters the requested feed page; exact SteamID64 values and official watch URLs resolve account status directly.
steambroadcast_chat_notice: Steam remote chat is pending. The displayed audience is the platform's current concurrent viewer count.
steambroadcast_restricted_notice: This Steam broadcast is account-restricted and remains unknown rather than appearing offline.
taobaolive_directory_scope: The current public portal does not expose a verified consumer directory. Native search accepts exact live IDs, creator IDs, official room links, and m.tb.cn share links.
taobaolive_room_scope: Taobao live-detail metadata is requested through a short-lived anonymous web session. An optional account cookie may improve access when the service requests verification.
taobaolive_chat_notice: Taobao remote chat is pending. viewCount is shown as cumulative session views, not current concurrent viewers; broadcaster followers remain separate.
taobaolive_restricted_notice: This Taobao room requires app or account access and remains unknown rather than appearing offline.
taobaolive_replay_notice: This Taobao live event is available as a replay; live playback lines are not advertised.
kugoulive_directory_scope: The official recommendation and category feeds use native pagination. Native search returns live and offline broadcasters; exact room IDs and official fanxing.kugou.com links resolve room status directly.
kugoulive_chat_notice: Kugou remote chat is pending. viewerNum/getViewerNum is shown as current viewers, hot as platform popularity, and fansCount separately as followers.
kugoulive_restricted_notice: This Kugou room is access-restricted and remains unknown rather than appearing offline.
baidulive_directory_scope: The official recommendation feed and seven categories use native session pagination. Exact room IDs and official live.baidu.com room/share links resolve live or offline state; public web nickname search remains pending.
baidulive_restricted_notice: This Baidu room is payment- or access-restricted and remains unknown rather than appearing offline.
baidulive_chat_notice: Baidu remote chat is pending. Directory audience_count and room online_users are shown as current viewers; broadcaster followers remain separate.
jdlive_directory_scope: The official featured feed uses native thirty-card pages. Keyword search filters the requested feed page; exact live IDs and official lives.jd.com room links resolve status directly.
jdlive_restricted_notice: This JD room is restricted to the JD app and remains unknown rather than appearing offline.
jdlive_chat_notice: JD remote chat is pending. The public directory's pv field is shown as cumulative views, not current concurrent viewers.
seventeen_directory_scope: The public JP recommendation feed uses its native cursor, not a full-site directory. Search covers the website's current-live window; exact room IDs and official room/profile links remain available, but offline nicknames are not indexed here.
seventeen_age_notice: 17LIVE requires viewers to be 18 or older.
looklive_directory_scope: Official video and voice recommendations keep their native pagination. Keyword search filters only the current official recommendation page; exact room numbers and look.163.com live links resolve live or offline state.
looklive_restricted_notice: This LOOK room has private-room or account access conditions; the state remains unknown.
looklive_app_only_notice: This room type has no web media exposed by the official site; view it in the LOOK client.
looklive_chat_notice: LOOK remote chat is pending. Official popularity remains platform heat, while onlineNumber is displayed separately as current viewers.
zhanqi_directory_scope: The official directory is currently a finite snapshot dominated by historical events and replay programs. Registration still requires a byte-verified media sample. Native search accepts an exact room code or official room URL.
zhanqi_chat_notice: Remote Zhanqi chat is pending. The directory online field is displayed as platform popularity, not concurrent viewers.
langlive_directory_scope: The first stage accepts an exact Lang Live account or an official main/room URL. The public directory contract is still being verified.
langlive_chat_notice: Remote Lang Live chat is pending. Concurrent viewers stay unknown when the platform does not provide an explicit count.
liveme_directory_scope: Uses LiveMe's public trending directory and native creator search. Search may include offline creators and the directory follows official pagination.
liveme_chat_notice: LiveMe remote chat is pending. Heat, current viewers, and cumulative viewers stay separate.
bigo_directory_scope: The official public directory is a finite recommendation snapshot, not a complete catalog. Filter current recommendations by host or title; exact Bigo IDs and official room URLs are queried separately.
bigo_chat_notice: Bigo Live remote chat is pending. Directory user_count is shown as current viewers only for active cards; missing room-detail values stay unknown.
bigo_login_required: This room currently requires sign-in, so its live state and media remain unknown.
bigo_access_restricted: This room is password- or payment-restricted, so its live state and media remain unknown.
tiktok_directory_scope: The first adapter stage supports exact handles, @handles, official profile/live URLs, and live share URLs. The guest public recommendation catalog depends on a web session, so this entry keeps its scope explicit.
tiktok_chat_notice: TikTok LIVE remote chat is pending. Concurrent viewers and cumulative room entries stay separate.
